experiments.why: A minor-flagged image at R, the lowest unsafe level, must stay hidden with minorDisabled now that safe-level minor images are let through.
Building the new minor-or-safe-level BitDex filter must still resolve to a result or null, not reject, when the query cannot run.

source.quote: returns aggregate feedDrop { droppedNoImages=M, total=N } and does NOT call the sink

obligations.statement: For type 'models', filterPreferences drops each model left with no image inside the browsing level, counts it in hidden.noImages, and returns an aggregate feedDrop whose droppedNoImages is the number dropped and whose total is the number of models given.
obligations.why: the quote is not inside a test in src/components/HiddenPreferences/__tests__/useApplyHiddenPreferences.test.ts that calls filterPreferences

source.quote: filterPreferences — models drop metadata is PURE (no telemetry side-effect)

obligations.statement: filterPreferences never calls the emitFeedNoImagesDrop telemetry sink; it only returns the drop metadata.
obligations.why: the quote is not inside a test in src/components/HiddenPreferences/__tests__/useApplyHiddenPreferences.test.ts that calls filterPreferences

source.quote: emits exactly ONE aggregate event when a page drops M>0 models

obligations.statement: When a page of models drops one or more models for having no images, useApplyHiddenPreferences calls emitFeedNoImagesDrop exactly once per commit with the aggregate event.

source.quote: is silent when M=0 (no page drop → the effect never calls the sink)

obligations.statement: When no model on the page drops, useApplyHiddenPreferences never calls emitFeedNoImagesDrop.

source.quote: hidden image can never silently leak into the lazily-loaded tail.

obligations.statement: For type 'images', filterPreferences never returns an image that the viewer's hidden preferences hide.
obligations.why: the quote is not inside a test in src/components/HiddenPreferences/__tests__/useApplyHiddenPreferences.test.ts that calls filterPreferences

source.quote: Returns { ids, total_matched, elapsed_us, docs? } or null on error.

obligations.statement: getImagesFromBitdexPreFilter resolves to { ids, total_matched, elapsed_us, docs? }, or to null when the query fails, instead of rejecting.
